description: Defines the NotificationItem class which models a local notification with serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: NotificationItem
classes.description: Represents a local notification stored in preferences with fields like id, title, body, creation time, and read status. Provides methods for marking as read and converting to/from JSON.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Returns a new NotificationItem instance with the read status set to true.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the NotificationItem instance into a JSON-serializable map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a NotificationItem from a JSON map.

methods.name: encodeList
methods.description: Serializes a list of NotificationItem objects into a JSON string.

methods.name: decodeList
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a list of NotificationItem objects.
